evidence: No credible news outlet reported a formal statement from the Lebanese Armed Forces confirming Israeli fire near their troops between 2026-07-28 and 2026-07-31. note: No verifiable public statement from the Lebanese Armed Forces meeting the criterion was published in a credible outlet during the window.
